reviews.title: Mushrooms
reviews.text: Doesn’t specify you can use them or not

reviews.title: Not for me
reviews.text:
When checked against 2 good field guides and verified with spore prints, this app is correct about 80% of the time. That’s acceptable for what I would use it for, a preliminary assessment to follow up on. What’s not acceptable is the ANNOYING ads every time I use it. Stupid music with obnoxious sound effects and you can’t get rid of it. You are held hostage and forced to watch the ad to the end. If you try to ID another shroom, you must endure it again. 
I deleted the app.

reviews.title: RIP OFF
reviews.text: Adverted as “free” on a pop up ad, and of course after install, and wasting time with a little jingle intro, another screen informs you have a seven day trial with option to be reminded that is $29.99 / year. Wonderful. Gets a one star for being another deceptive scam.

reviews.title: Mushroom toxicity
reviews.text: The add on TV demonstrates a banner after a mushroom is identified that says if it’s toxic or not. I am unable to do that and my app is up to date. I cannot get an answer as to how to turn on this feature.

reviews.title: Misidentified
reviews.text: I just bought these from a local fruit and vegetable grocery store. Your app is saying they’re toxic. It’s calling them white dome caps. And they are snow/seafood mushrooms.

reviews.title: Don’t recommend
reviews.text: This app isn’t really helpful. When o take a pic from this app i expect to tell me n tone name  like “edible or poisonous” I shouldn’t copy the name and go to google to answer me this question.  Second, I can take a picture of the same mushrooms 3 times and it gives me different identification. How safe is it?  I have been charge for something I can’t fully trust.

reviews.title: No toxicity guidance
reviews.text: The app used to tell you if the mushrooms are safe to consume or not, which is why I paid for the subscription… but apparently they now just have a generic warning that the information can’t be used to determine if it’s safe to consume. Won’t be renewing unless this changes.

reviews.title: Poor connection every
reviews.text:
I’m done with this app. More often than not it shows “poor connection” regardless of my cellular strength in a location. Then just saw on Reddit that they share your photos. DONE. 
Was getting mostly correct ID’s, when it works, but not always.  I ALWAYS further research any result anyway. Especially for edibles.

reviews.title: Wrong!
reviews.text: The mushroom I wanted to identify is only found in Western Europe. Problem is, my mushroom was found in the US PNW.

reviews.title: No Support Subscription
reviews.text: Downloaded this app and before I was able to delete it I was charge $29.99 they give you a subscription window and then tell you later you need to delete a day before your free version is over. There is absolutely no way to contact anyone regarding the app making customer support services impossible. The app is canceled but I’m stuck paying $29.99 for a year of not using the app. Don’t download this app if you’re not sure you want to keep it.

reviews.title: PAID SUBSCRIPTION
reviews.text: i understand we all have to deal with capitalism, but come on, make payment optional for people who want to support a good product. Otherwise, you turn away potential users

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: They say they will remind you before your trial is up, then just take your money without doing so. Now I’ve spent£30 on an app I will never use. Stupid of me but if they did what they said they would it wouldn’t have happened
